content.text:
Users need an at-a-glance view of line health and recurring problems, separable by ACX client.

Acceptance criteria:
- Summary tiles show success rate over a selected period.
- Failures are broken down by stage.
- Failures are broken down by client, with a client filter available.
- A repeat-offender list is shown for DDIs failing repeatedly.
- A trend-over-time view is available.
